summary: Verified StoryShareModal bug fix end-to-end. Backend proxy /api/img-proxy returns 200 with image/* content-type and access-control-allow-origin: * for both an arbitrary Unsplash URL and a real product image URL (cdn.saatvesaat.com.tr). Frontend E2E: after setting localStorage userRole=admin and reloading a product detail page (/product/7W6orN9BG5PwqmIBfi9w), the admin-story-share-btn appears; clicking opens story-share-modal; canvas renders with a blob: preview src; PNG yüklə (story-share-download) becomes enabled; no 'Şəkil yüklənmədi' or 'CORS səbəbindən yüklənmədi' warning appears on any of the four templates (minimal, pure, silhouette, noir). Pixel-stat sanity (center 300x300 std >= 42) confirms real image content (not a plain gradient). Screenshots visually confirm the watch product photo is drawn inside each template with the redesigned soft white→tint gradients and price/brand/credit labels.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductService.getAll logs run 12x on homepage load; consider memoizing/caching to avoid redundant Firestore reads.
Homepage networkidle never resolves (some long-lived request); not blocking but affects tests using wait_for_load_state('networkidle').
test_credentials: Simulated admin via localStorage.setItem('userRole','admin'); userId='test-admin'. No real login required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Story share modal test flow: goto /product/<id>, set localStorage userRole=admin + userId, reload, JS-click [data-testid=admin-story-share-btn] (regular Playwright click may time out due to viewport calc), wait 8-9s for canvas render then check preview blob src, absence of error text, and pixel stats. Backend img-proxy allows arbitrary hosts and returns ACAO:*.
rca of the issue: Original bug: product image failed to draw into story canvas because production Vercel /api/img-proxy was 404 and the FastAPI proxy had a host whitelist. Fix in main agent: added Vercel og.js handler + vercel.json rewrite (not testable in preview) and relaxed FastAPI whitelist to allow any public host with SSRF guard. Verified in preview by curling backend proxy (200 + ACAO:*) and by running the modal end-to-end which now renders the product image on all four templates.
